label: Bible Study
prompt: But God hath chosen the _____ things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;
verse: But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;
note: God's recruiting strategy — the foolish and the weak, to put the wise and mighty in their place.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And God _____ Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
verse: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
note: After long years of waiting, God remembered Rachel — and Joseph was born.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy _____, and walk.
verse: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
note: Thirty-eight years by the pool, then three commands from Jesus: rise, take up thy bed, and walk.

label: Deep Water
prompt: _____ no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
verse: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
note: The one debt Paul says you can never pay off — love one another, and the law is fulfilled.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man _____ and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
verse: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
note: Joseph's advice to Pharaoh: find a man 'discreet and wise' — and Pharaoh promptly decided Joseph was that man (41:39).
